detail: The first final-gates execution returned R7_write_scope=false because the instrument read git porcelain status through a helper that strips leading whitespace. The first porcelain line (' M evaluation/state/evaluation.json') lost its leading space, so the path slice at index 3 produced 'valuation/state/evaluation.json' and was adjudicated out-of-scope. The workflow predicate (.github/workflows/core-lane.yml:137-143) uses the untrimmed line, so this was a defect in this run's port, not a real lane scope crossing and not a control-plane defect.
fix: Use an untrimmed git-status reader (gits_raw) for the write-scope predicate; the case-pattern allowlist is unchanged from core-lane.yml:140.
claim_ceiling: Implementation-time repair of a read-only verification port. No product measurement was taken between the failed and corrected executions, no success rule or threshold was changed to obtain a pass, and the failed record is preserved as a negative result.
